name: Google
description: Configure a Google Cloud project, OAuth consent screen and OAuth client.
approval: Verification may be required for sensitive or restricted scopes and public distribution.

steps.title: Create or select a Google Cloud project
steps.detail: Use a project dedicated to the integration where practical.

steps.title: Configure OAuth consent screen
steps.detail: Set app name, support email, audience and developer contact details.

steps.title: Add scopes and test users
steps.detail: Request minimum scopes. During testing, add permitted test users when applicable.

steps.title: Create OAuth client credentials
steps.detail: Choose the correct application type and register exact authorized redirect URIs.

steps.title: Test and assess verification
steps.detail: Test authorization and check whether requested scopes require verification.

requirements: Scope justification and verification materials if applicable
blockers: Unverified apps may show user warnings or have user limits
Incorrect redirect URI causes authorization errors
agent_can_do: Explain OAuth flow and scope choices
human_must_do: Sign in to Google Cloud Console
Own the project and verify domains if needed
verification: Guide checked against official Google developer and support documentation. No console setup or verification submission was performed.

name: Slack
description: Create a Slack app, configure OAuth scopes and install it to a workspace.
approval: Workspace installation and admin approval may depend on workspace policies.

steps.title: Create a Slack app
steps.detail: Create an app in the Slack API dashboard, using a manifest or from scratch.

steps.title: Configure redirect URLs
steps.detail: Add the exact OAuth redirect URL used by your application.

steps.title: Select bot and user scopes
steps.detail: Choose only the scopes needed for the integration and understand which token type they apply to.

steps.title: Install to a development workspace
steps.detail: Run the OAuth flow and review the permissions requested on the consent screen.

steps.title: Test token and API calls
steps.detail: Verify the callback, token storage and one representative API call.

blockers: Workspace admins may restrict app installation
Scopes may require reinstallation after changes
agent_can_do: Map product actions to likely Slack scopes
human_must_do: Create and own the Slack app
verification: Guide checked against official Slack API documentation. No workspace installation or admin approval was performed.

name: GitHub
description: Register an OAuth App and configure callback URLs and requested scopes.
approval: A basic OAuth App can be registered by an account owner; organization policies can affect access.

steps.title: Open Developer settings
steps.detail: Navigate to your account or organization developer settings and create an OAuth App.

steps.title: Enter application details
steps.detail: Provide homepage URL, application description and authorization callback URL.

steps.title: Generate client secret
steps.detail: Create the client secret and store it in a server-side secret manager.

steps.title: Choose minimum scopes
steps.detail: Request only the permissions needed for your product's GitHub API actions.

steps.title: Test authorization code flow
steps.detail: Test callback handling, code exchange and token use with a development account.

requirements: GitHub account with permission to create OAuth Apps
Scope list and secure secret storage
blockers: Organization policy can restrict OAuth app access
OAuth Apps have limitations compared with GitHub Apps
Callback mismatch or insecure token handling
agent_can_do: Compare OAuth App and GitHub App trade-offs
human_must_do: Register the app while signed in
verification: Guide checked against official GitHub documentation. No app registration or authorization test was performed.

name: Notion
description: Create a public integration, configure OAuth redirect URI and request workspace access.
approval: Workspace owner/admin authorization is part of connecting an integration; distribution requirements can vary.

steps.title: Create an integration
steps.detail: Create an integration in the Notion developer portal and choose the appropriate distribution type.

steps.title: Configure OAuth settings
steps.detail: Set the redirect URI and review the client credentials for the integration.

steps.title: Define capabilities
steps.detail: Select the minimum content capabilities needed by the integration.

steps.title: Run the authorization flow
steps.detail: Ask a workspace owner to authorize the integration and select the pages it can access.

steps.title: Test access
steps.detail: Use the resulting token to verify access only to pages shared with the integration.

blockers: Integration only sees pages shared with it
Public distribution setup may need additional review
human_must_do: Complete any required distribution or review steps
verification: Guide checked against official Notion developer documentation. No integration creation or workspace authorization was performed.
